text:
elena: Heads-up — CI showed a weird spike in MTEB NDCG variance for the rerank runner on the new quantized model. Numbers are way off for fold 3 compared to local runs. Anyone touched the fold splitting logic recently?

raj: Hmm, I saw that too. Quick check: are we still using the dataset permutation code in eval_harness/splits.py? Iirc there was a tweak last month to try to make shuffling faster.

marta: I dug in a bit. The culprit looks like this snippet in split util: 
```python
# bad: uses global RNG, no seed per-run
def make_folds(dataset, k):
    p = np.random.permutation(len(dataset))
    folds = np.array_split(p, k)
    return folds
```
This causes different workers and CI runs to pick overlapping indices when cached shards are used — index leakage across folds.

elena: Ugh. That explains why NDCG for the same query ids changed between CI and my laptop (I was using fixed seed via sklearn). Should be deterministic.

raj: Proposed fix: switch to sklearn.model_selection.StratifiedKFold with shuffle=True and random_state=seed when labels exist, otherwise use np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation. Also we should assert no overlap in the harness after split.

marta: Agree. I'll add an assert in the runner tests: 
```python
# in tests/test_splits.py
def test_no_overlap_across_folds():
    folds = make_folds(ds, k=5, seed=42)
    for i, a in enumerate(folds):
        for j, b in enumerate(folds):
            if i != j:
                assert set(a).isdisjoint(b)
```
And a small smoke that recomputes folds from raw dataset with the same seed to catch regressions in CI.

sam: Also worth updating the eval-collector to emit per-fold "query_ids" and a checksum so we can quickly diff runs and detect when the split changes. Right now the collector aggregates metrics only — we lose the mapping.

elena: Good call. We saw duplicate query_ids in the logs which made MRR/NDCG unstable. Deduping queries before computing rerank metrics is a bandaid but we should fix the splitting first.

marta: PR opened: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/481>. Changes: deterministic fold logic, new unit test, collector emits fold checksums. PTAL @raj @sam.

raj: Reviewing now. One small nit: for low-shot tasks where labels are missing, fallback to GroupKFold? Or just stratify by task id? We should document behavior per-dataset.

marta: I'll add a doc comment and a table in docs/evals.md that lists strategy per task type.

eval-bot: CI / mteb-smoke — run 27: passed. No fold overlap. Baseline diff: NDCG changes within tolerance for 19/20 tasks, single outlier flagged.

elena: Thanks all. After merge I'll trigger a full MTEB run and post the per-fold checksums. If the outlier persists we'll drill into that dataset specifically. :mag: :thumbsup:
